साउथ सिनेमा और बिजनेस वर्ल्ड की सबसे बड़ी वेडिंग रिसेप्शन पार्टी में सितारों का मेला लग चुका है! ✨

Anirudh Ravichander और Kavya Maran के Marriage Reception में शामिल होने के लिए मनोरंजन और खेल जगत की कई नामी हस्तियां Chennai पहुंचीं।

इस ग्रैंड रिसेप्शन में भारतीय सिनेमा के दो बड़े दिग्गज Kamal Haasan और Rajinikanth एक साथ कैमरे के सामने मुस्कुराते हुए पोज देते नजर आए। 📸

Tollywood सुपरस्टार Mahesh Babu भी इस खास मौके पर शुभकामनाएं देने खास तौर पर Chennai पहुंचे, वहीं New Zealand के स्टार क्रिकेटर Kane Williamson भी रिसेप्शन में स्पॉट किए गए। 🎉

इवेंट की चर्चा तब और बढ़ गई जब Thalapathy Vijay और Sangeetha ने इस रिसेप्शन पार्टी में अलग-अलग एंट्री ली।

रिसेप्शन से सामने आई दिग्गजों की इस लिस्ट में आपकी पसंदीदा जोड़ी कौन सी है? कमेंट्स में जरूर शेयर करें! 💬

#AnirudhRavichander #KavyaMaran #Rajinikanth #KamalHaasan #MaheshBabu #ThalapathyVijay #CineChaska

ctx.title: Ramayana Part One Box Office Collections:  Ranbir Kapoor and Yash starrer grows well on 3rd Saturday, Set to cross Rs. 900 Cr today
ctx.summary:
Ramayana: Part One collected Rs. 27 crore nett approx on its 3rd Saturday, including nearly Rs. 20 crore nett in Hindi. The growth from Friday was around 80 per cent, with Hindi being slightly higher. Its cumulative domestic box office now stands at Rs. 877 crore nett approx, and it is set to cross the Rs. 900 crore nett milestone today. 
 The film is performing well in South India and Maharashtra. Unfortunately, the Hindi heartland is rather ordinary. This is ironic because one would expect a film like Ramayana to outperform there. The numbers may still look somewhat fine, but when one looks at the footfalls, the situation is dire, as the film is barely over 2 crore in two weeks. 
 As for why this has happened, there are a couple of plausible factors. For decades, audiences have consumed Ramayana largely through TV serials that emphasised emotion and melodrama. This film felt more like a Hollywood-style spectacle, which may not have resonated as well with them. Also, there has been unwarranted negativity against the film over the last year or so. While one may like to just look the other way, these things do take a toll when repeated time and time again. The marketing arguably failed to counter those, and it felt a lot more subdued than a film of this size should be. All these factors have compounded, and the film has fallen a lot short of its potential. 
 While the business is BLOCKBUSTER or even SUPER BLOCKBUSTER level, it needed to be more than that, not just for its cost
